lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What kind of rolled omelet do you like?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Salty?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Or sweet?
Uh, why do you ask?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Since I got my uniform and all,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I wanted us to text like classmates. I could be the new girl, and you could be the older guy who helps me adjust.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is it okay if we have that kind of dynamic?
Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: In terms of specifics,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: like for your character,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and for my character,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I do have a setup in mind,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but that's not important at the moment.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I had to say one thing,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you're the kind of classmate who is super dependable,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: even if you may not look like it.
You've... put a lot of thought into this.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: With that all in mind,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I ask you again,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: do you prefer salty rolled omelets,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: or sweet ones?
Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're going to say both, right?
Both.
Hah,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I knew it.
How'd you know?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I could probably bring you anything,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: even something burnt,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and you'd still say it was good.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Feel free to tell me I'm wrong.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But the fact that you'd enjoy whatever I make,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: actually makes it harder for me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I'm going to make something,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to make what you actually like.
This is all just part of your character, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why do you ask?
If I had a classmate like that,
I think I'd end up falling for her.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I mean, that's pretty much how this story always goes,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: so that's perfect.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, that's all I wanted to ask.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've got some things to do, so I'll text again later.
You're already busy? With what?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's a secret!
